title: I don't use ai much, but damn it changed my game with its music
author: _Diocletian_
selftext:
So yeah..

  
I got beaten up a bit for having AI music (Here is my first review, and the ONLY NEGATIVE review so far: *Had this game wishlisted as the premise looks neat, unfortunately the final product has generative ai. having the ai music toggleable does not make it okay, it's like bandaging a fatal wound*)

  
But still, it changed my game for the better. I cherry-picked a lot of course, but using mostly Suno 5.5 I got the perfect musics for my game. 

I tried a bunch of prompts, mostly variations of "chiptune with heavy beats", the opening of the album is "Dark chiptune vivaldi with heavy beat", didn't used their editing tools.

Truth be told, I like my better with this music than without.

  
Yet I probably won't use it for the next one. That stupid negative review aside, it caused a lot of "gentle" negative feedback in the niche creators. The only type of creators I can reach with my small projects. Not all of them, but a good significant portion. I'd say about half. 

It's not that it costs me sales (which it probably does). Sales aren't amounting to much so I don't really care about them yet. But it costs exposure.

  
And as I have been told you should never be shy about showing your game, so if you are curious [here](http://store.steampowered.com/app/4139330/Particulitix) it is

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: Or find the best of both worlds. I'm not a music guy, but what you could also do is be inspired by the suno outputs and with the help of gpt is setup a music composer and try to replicate your ai generated results and learn as you go. With enough hand holding you could probably make a knock off but now it's not ai. I haven't tried music composition but it was something I wanted to try with my game. Just a thought

replies.author: _Diocletian_
replies.body:
I'm not a music guy either and can't see how I would be able to replicate this by hear 😃 

But I like the idea of having the partition. I would like to turn my game into a midi player

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: I'm just saying with most of those interfaces you could probably have gpt handhold you through the experience and get a usable result based off the generated one.
